observed_pattern: In all five examples, a displacement and a slope threshold are exceeded in 8/8 windows from 10.0 to 45.0 h, although the involved XMEAS variables and sign sequences vary.
XMEAS-7 has above-threshold residual variability in 8/8 windows, including 2/2 initial and 2/2 final windows, in four of five examples; it is also the maximum-dispersion variable in every example.
